summary: Dedrick Point ground lookout, Trinity Co., CA: 1933-34 station at Balsam grove, road open 1934; FFLA lists it Gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Lookout station with a cement foundation (Oct 1933 item, as quoted on Forest Lookouts)
facts.status_note: FFLA's California list marks it Gone. No source gives a removal date or method.

events.note: Under construction: lumber to be hauled to Balsam grove for the fire lookout, which was advancing rapidly (Courier-Free Press, Sept 1933, as quoted on Forest Lookouts)
Oct 1933 item (Courier Searchlight, as quoted): new station at Balsam grove about two-thirds finished, cement foundation
Planned staffing: Mr. and Mrs. John Biddle to be in charge of the lookout (Sept 1933 item). A plan only; no source confirms they served.
Lookout road: crews working on it in June 1934; June item says it joins the lookout with Canyon creek road; August item says the road is open to the lookout

notes_for_editor: Brief matches the sources (Trinity County, ground, Gone). The 1933-34 construction, staffing plan and road details come only from newspaper excerpts quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; the newspapers themselves were not read. The 1933 staffing item is a plan, so it is not logged as staffed. No removal date or method found anywhere. The Trinity County list page gives the location as 35N-10W-36. No FFLOS or NHLR register entry found (firetower.org California index has no match). No photos found.
